q1_what_did_you_play: Rapid Fire first, consuming the 3 Sparks, then Kaboom! on Nibbit, then Duck and Cover.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Kaboom! first and Rapid Fire second, spending all 2 Energy on Rapid Fire and forgoing defense.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up nothing in immediate attack damage versus that alternative; it gave up the possibility of preserving the Sparks for a different attack ordering, in exchange for 5 Block.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had not intended to attack, I would have omitted Duck and Cover and played Kaboom! first, then Rapid Fire at its printed cost of 2.
